recentItems.title: How curiosity saved me from a doomsday cult | Gabrielle Steele | TEDxAirlie
recentItems.description:
What if the opposite of certainty isn’t doubt, but curiosity? Gabrielle Steele reflects on her 21 years inside an apocalyptic cult and how unquestioned beliefs can quietly shape identity, morality, and belonging. Through her personal story and research, she shows how curiosity disrupts inherited certainty and becomes a pathway back to empathy, responsibility, and freedom. 

Gabrielle Steele grew up in a cult — and lived to laugh about it. Now a clinical trials project manager with a master’s in Exercise Physiology, she blends science and satire to explore how we form and fiercely defend our beliefs — in cults, politics, and corporate culture alike. Through humor, resilience, and sharp insight, Gabrielle challenges audiences to question their certainties and trade judgment for curiosity.

When she’s not speaking or writing, she’s mentoring others, riding her bike, and raising two sons — approaching life, like a long ride, with endurance, humility, and a little mischief. 

This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.description: What happens when life changes the path you thought you were meant to follow? From becoming a chef and working in a three-Michelin-star kitchen to discovering a new way to stay connected with food through writing, travel, and culinary experiences, this talk explores the power of passion, resilience, and reinvention. Sometimes, changing direction isn’t leaving your dream behind—it’s finding a new way to li Akanksha Dean is a distinguished lifestyle writer with a passion for travel, food, and culture. A graduate of IHM Aurangabad in partnership with Huddersfield University, UK, she seamlessly blends global experiences into her evocative storytelling. recentItems.title: Who Wrote Your Mind? The Architecture of Belief | Ms. Swatee Jog | TEDxBirla Intl School Youth
recentItems.description: Who Wrote Your Brain: The Narrative Architecture of Human Belief explores how our thoughts, beliefs, and identity are shaped by family, experiences, education, culture, and the world around us. Swatee Jog explains how the brain turns experiences into stories that influence the way we see ourselves and make decisions. She encourages us to question the beliefs we have carried for years and understand where they came from. The talk shows how changing the stories we tell ourselves can change the way we see possibilities and choices. Ultimately, it invites us to ask: Who wrote the voice inside my head, and which parts of the story will I choose to rewrite? Swatee Jog is the founder of Eeshanya Ventures, a media and branding company. With over 20 years of corporate experience, she now creates ad films, corporate films, writes books, and helps individuals and organizations communicate through storytelling and narrative architecture. She is a podcast host, event anchor, columnist, and Co-Convener of the INTACH Belagavi Chapter, where she actively promotes heritage awareness. Fascinated by how stories shape people, brands, and societies, Swatee has a knack for connecting the dots in unexpected ways. She loves cars, dreams of seeing the Northern Lights, and believes life is better with good food. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: Kaleidoscope of Dreams | Dr. Amogh Laxman Jambagi | TEDxBirla Intl School Youth
recentItems.description: What if the path you never planned becomes the one that defines you? From cricket and a failed medical exam to becoming an ophthalmologist and creating VARDAAN, this talk explores how failure, curiosity, and unexpected choices can connect in remarkable ways. Because sometimes, the most meaningful stories are built from pieces we never knew belonged together. Dr. Amogh Laxman Jambagi is a fellowship-trained cornea and refractive surgeon driven by a unique intersection of clinical excellence and inventive spirit. As the Medical Director at Jambagi Super Speciality Eye Institute, he blends complex surgical expertise with a passion for democratizing medical education—most notably through "VARDAAN," his frugal virtual reality microscope designed to revolutionize surgical training. A multi-award-winning innovator recognized for his contributions to ophthalmology, Dr. Jambagi views his career as a dynamic, evolving tapestry of problem-solving. He is dedicated to transforming vision care through technology, research, and a relentless commitment to "creating" solutions that push the boundaries of modern medicine. recentItems.title: Belagavi as a Blueprint | Dr. Hitha M. Hebbalkar | TEDxBirla Intl School Youth
recentItems.description: Belagavi as a Blueprint challenges the belief that excellence, innovation, and opportunity belong only to metropolitan cities. Dr. Hitha M Hebbalkar shares her decision to build her medical practice in Belagavi, choosing where her skills were needed over where she could more easily build a reputation. Her journey demonstrates that a smaller city does not have to mean smaller science, lower standards, or lesser opportunities. She also reflects on challenging traditional expectations placed on women and creating an identity through her own work and choices. The talk presents Belagavi as a blueprint for meaningful change—showing that progress begins when we stop asking what we are allowed to do and start asking what needs to be done. Dr. Hitha M. Hebbalkar is a Consulting Dermatologist and founder of Dr. Hebbalkar's Skin & Hair Clinic, Belagavi. She completed her MBBS from Mysore Medical College & Research Institute and her MD in Dermatology, Venereology & Leprology from JJM Medical College, Davangere. With advanced observerships in cosmetology from Delhi and Mumbai and an international paper presentation at the International Dermatology Conference (IDC) 2024 in Paris, she combines clinical expertise with innovation to inspire healthier lives through skin and hair care This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community.
